shellCommands.command: cd /workspace && cat next.config.ts && echo "---APP---" && find app __agent_eval__ -type f | head -40 && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json
cat app/layout.tsx && echo "---PAGE---" && cat app/page.tsx && echo "---EVAL---" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -60

ls 01-app/02-guides/ | head -40 && echo "===V16===" && grep -rn -i "cookies\|next/headers\|accept-language" 01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md 2>/dev/null | head -30; find . -path "*upgrading*" -name "*.md"
cd /workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20 && echo "=== TSC EXIT: $? ===" && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && echo "=== NO COOKIE, en-US ===" && curl -s -H "Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9,fr;q=0.8" localhost:3111 | grep -o '<section>.*</section>' && echo && echo "=== theme=dark, fr preferred by q ===" && curl -s -H "Cookie: theme=dark" -H "Accept-Language: en;q=0.3,fr-CA;q=0.9" localhost:3111 | grep -o '<section>.*</section>' && echo && echo "=== garbage cookie, no A-L header ===" && curl -s -H "Cookie: theme=hotpink" -H "Accept-Language;" localhost:3111 | grep -o '<section>.*</section>'
(pkill -f "next start" || true) && git diff --stat && git status --short
